findings.title: Rehearse mode creates its target directory even during `--check`
findings.description: The script creates `$REHEARSE` before processing steps, including in `--check` mode. This violates the documented guarantee that check mode changes nothing; the tests only check that selected children are absent, not that the rehearsal root itself remains uncreated. Guard this `mkdir` so check mode stays read-only.

findings.title: Cutover can mark an unverified weekly backup as armed
findings.description: `step_weekly` treats a zero exit code and a `=== weekly backup done (unarmed)` log line as success, then creates `RECONCILE-ARMED`. The weekly script explicitly emits that unarmed completion when it skips the destructive reconcile, and its base-backup path can still fail to create the expected base backup while completing that path. Before arming, verify that the expected base backup exists and is valid (and that the intended reconcile checks completed); the current check only inspects the final log line and exit status.

findings.title: Health and offsite checks ignore the cron job's exit status
findings.description: `run_health` discards the `shell()` result and trusts the last line of the health log. A failed health command can therefore be accepted if the log contains a previous clean summary. Similarly, `step_offsite` ignores the push command’s result and proceeds to `rclone check`; if that check passes against an existing remote copy, the step can pass despite the failed push. Check and record each command’s return code, and fail on nonzero results rather than relying on potentially stale logs or later checks.

findings.title: Python tool configuration does not meet the required type-checking configuration
findings.description: The project config uses `[tool.mypy]` with only `python_version`, `files`, and `ignore_missing_imports`; it does not provide the required strict checking, include of both `src` and `tests`, or the specified missing-import/type-stub settings. The new cutover modules and tests therefore are not mechanically covered by the configured checker. Add the required strict configuration (or an equivalent strict mypy configuration that includes the changed Python files and tests).
